content.summary: Work items generated from commit plan for collapsible/filter sidebar

work_items.title: Add collapsible directory nodes to FileList with stable selection
acceptance_criteria: Directory header rows render ▶/▼ toggle indicators and are clickable to collapse/expand
Space key on a directory-header row toggles collapse
Collapsing a directory hides its child file rows from visibleRows
Selection remaps to nearest visible file when current selection is hidden by collapse
Collapse state survives list navigation and refetch; pruned when paths disappear
Stage grouping (staged/unstaged/untracked) is preserved — collapse is per-directory within each stage
onSelect payload shape (FileSelection) is unchanged
bun run typecheck passes

work_items.title: Add fuzzy filename filter with keyboard isolation
acceptance_criteria: '/' hotkey activates an inline filter <input> at the top of the file list
Typing in the filter input scores files by path using fuzzysort and hides non-matching files
Parent directory headers remain visible when any descendant matches
When filter is active, collapse state is ignored (all matching files visible regardless of collapse)
Escape in filter mode clears filter text and exits editing mode
While filter input is focused, j/k/r/up/down hotkeys are suppressed in file-list keyboard handler
Route-level hotkeys (S submit, Esc close) still work when filter is not focused
When filter is cleared, previous selection is restored if still in the file list
bun run typecheck passes

work_items.title: Update ChangesFooter with collapse and filter hotkey hints
acceptance_criteria: Footer shows '/ filter' hint
Footer shows 'space toggle' hint when a directory row is highlighted
Existing hints (esc close, ↑↓ navigate, c comment, S submit) are preserved
bun run typecheck passes

work_items.title: Manual runtime verification: keyboard, comment reset, duplicate submit
acceptance_criteria: Verified: up/down/j/k navigate through files, skipping collapsed directories
Verified: enter selects a file and DiffPane loads its diff
Verified: '/' opens filter, typing filters files, Escape clears and restores navigation
Verified: j/k/r keys do NOT trigger while filter input is focused
Verified: c (comment) works when filter is NOT focused
Verified: S (submit) works from any state, and setComments(() => []) clears all comments before navigation
Verified: after submit + navigation back to /changes, no prior comments are present
Verified: pressing S twice rapidly does not duplicate-submit (comments.length === 0 guard fires)
Verified: collapse + filter combined does not break selection or produce empty visible rows
